description: Generate and maintain TypeScript types for all microservice APIs from OpenAPI specs. Current state: frontend manually types API responses (see `useApiRequest<T>` pattern), missing runtime validation. Create: (1) Automated OpenAPI schema generation from FastAPI/Pydantic models, (2) Generated TypeScript client SDKs for each microservice endpoint, (3) Pydantic schema validation on request/response boundaries. Use tools like OpenAPI Generator or orval for code generation.
